en.summary: With a projected KD9.8bn deficit in the 2026/27 budget, Kuwait is pushing fiscal and legal reforms by decree, including higher non-oil revenue, a government sukuk law and a new arbitration law. Large port, airport and wastewater projects and a digital government drive centred on the Sahel app continue.

Legislation by Amiri decree while parliament is suspended
